transcript: Speaker A: Neha, tumhara ye jeans aur t-shirt bahut achchha hai. [Neha, your jeans and t-shirt are very nice.] Speaker B: Jeans aur t-shirt? Pronunciation seekh kar aao pehle, phir mujhse baat karna. [Jeans and t-shirt? Learn pronunciation first, then talk to me.] Speaker A: Vani, galat pronunciation ki wajah se sabke samne beizzati ho gayi. [Vani, I got embarrassed in front of everyone because of wrong pronunciation.] Speaker C: Dil chhota mat karo. Use jeans aur t-shirt bolte hain. [Don't lose heart. It's called jeans and t-shirt.] Speaker A: Mujhse hamesha aisi galtiyan hoti hain. Kya main kabhi sahi English bol paunga? [I always make such mistakes. Will I ever be able to speak correct English?] Speaker C: Hundred percent. Mere saath koi beizzati nahi hogi. Roz bas 15 minute practice karo aur 30 din mein farak dekho. [Hundred percent. With me, there will be no embarrassment. Just practice 15 minutes daily and see the difference in 30 days.] Speaker A: Sahi hai. Speak Easy App abhi download karta hoon. [Great. I'll download the Speak Easy App right now.] Speaker D: Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Speakeasy AI, Speak English Easily with Speakeasy, Install Now [Speakeasy AI, Speak English Easily with Speakeasy, Install Now]
summary: A man is mocked for his English pronunciation and turns to the Speakeasy AI assistant, Vani, for judgment-free practice. Vani corrects his pronunciation and promises improvement in 30 days with daily 15-minute practice. The ad concludes with a call to download the Speakeasy app.
